name: p5_thm5
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : 6 * n ^ 4 + 8 * n ^ 3 + 12 * n ^ 2 + 8 * n ≤ n.totient ^ 3 * (p5_dedekind_psi n + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) + p5_dedekind_psi n ^ 3 * (n.totient + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n ^ 3 * (n.totient + p5_dedekind_psi n) + 2
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), 6 * n ^ 4 + 8 * n ^ 3 + 12 * n ^ 2 + 8 * n ≤ n.totient ^ 3 * (p5_dedekind_psi n + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) + p5_dedekind_psi n ^ 3 * (n.totient + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n) + ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n ^ 3 * (n.totient + p5_dedekind_psi n) + 2
informal: Theorem 5: phi^3(psi+sigma)+psi^3(phi+sigma)+sigma^3(phi+psi) >= 6n^4+8n^3+12n^2+8n-2 for n >= 2 (the -2 moved to the other side to avoid natural subtraction).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → 6 * n ^ 4 + 8 * n ^ 3 + 12 * n ^ 2 + 8 * n ≤ n.totient ^ 3 * (Mathlib2.p5_dedekind_psi n + (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n) + Mathlib2.p5_dedekind_psi n ^ 3 * (n.totient + (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n) + (ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n ^ 3 * (n.totient + Mathlib2.p5_dedekind_psi n) + 2
